title.zh: 将孔波斯特拉谷省Compostela的Maparat描笼涯Maparat中学改设为国立中学，名称为Maparat国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Maparat High School in Barangay Maparat, Compostela, Compostela Valley Province into a National High School to be known as the Maparat National High School and appropriating funds thereof
title.orig: An Act Converting the Maparat High School in Barangay Maparat, Compostela, Compostela Valley Province into a National High School to be known as the Maparat National High School and appropriating funds thereof

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8771_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Maparat High School in Barangay Maparat, Compostela, Compostela Valley Province is hereby converted into a national high school to be known as the Maparat National High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall promulgate and issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to implement the provisions of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
